# Trust Foundation

PI1 validates required manifest fields, contract major, minimum HADocs version, required artifact set, typed artifact envelopes, per-file SHA-256, aggregate SHA-256 and canonical references. `TrustVerifier` is an injectable protocol; the current `UnsignedChecksumTrust` reports checksum-valid/signature-not-implemented. Checksums establish integrity relative to the manifest, not publisher authenticity.

Future distribution design: publish an immutable bundle plus signed manifest as a release artifact; install offline into a versioned local directory; verify signature against a pinned trust root before atomic activation; retain the previous validated version for rollback; define stable/beta channels, stale policy and explicit update approval. PI1 implements none of the download, channel, signature or automatic-update behavior.
